title: Introducing: New Microsoft Copilot Chat in Business Central (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to unified Microsoft Copilot experience
Copilot features and data access with Work IQ
Demo setup and new Copilot button
Querying Business Central data with permissions

features.name: Unified Microsoft Copilot Chat
features.description: A new unified Copilot experience across Microsoft products that accesses Business Central data while respecting user permissions and context.

features.name: Copilot with Work IQ integration
features.description: With additional Microsoft Copilot license, Copilot can access Work IQ data including calendar, emails, Teams conversations, files from OneDrive or SharePoint.

features.name: Copilot button in Business Central
features.description: A new Copilot button in the Business Central interface that opens the updated unified Copilot experience.

features.name: Copilot question answering on Business Central data
features.description: Copilot can answer questions about Business Central data as well as general questions, providing access to data in context with user permissions and company information.

features.name: Side-by-side data viewing with Copilot
features.description: Users can open data side by side with Copilot responses to read both the Copilot answer and the underlying Business Central data simultaneously.

features.name: Multi-turn Copilot conversation
features.description: Users can continue conversations with Copilot by asking follow-up questions about their Business Central data across multiple turns.

quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that Copilot queries Business Central data while respecting the user's specific context and permissions.
